correctness.rationale: At both filtration levels f-vectors and integer persistence agree by Euler rank and contractibility. Standard unweighted up-Laplacian is B B^T because the 1-skeleton is unchanged. Book Gram is 2I+11^T. Bipyramid Gram is the Dirichlet principal submatrix of the prism graph Laplacian, giving positive definiteness. A sinusoidal test vector gives upper O(n^-2), pinned-path Cauchy–Schwarz gives lower Omega(n^-2), Gershgorin gives max<=6. Local checker replays for n=3..12; no finite run substitutes for proof.

value.rationale: Same integral barcode and even full stagewise face vector may obscure an arbitrarily large relative error in the most commonly used positive up-Laplacian spectral gap; this shows the severity of non-harmonic information loss in a natural exact benchmark. Sharp quadratic order and linear top-spectrum separation distinguish the branching triangle-book regime from a nonbranching triangulated disk, providing spectral stress-test families for persistent Laplacian summaries.
